meta.notes: Metering data for the `elforbrug` widget, from Eloverblik (Energinet DataHub). CREDENTIAL RULE: the refresh token lives only in n8n's encrypted credential store as an HTTP Header Auth credential named `eloverblik` (header Authorization, value 'Bearer <refresh token>'). Jytte holds no energy credential and has no Python client - the widget is source: n8n. BEFORE ACTIVATING: log in at eloverblik.dk with MitID, create a refresh token under your name top right (valid one year), add it as that credential, and repoint the 'Hent data access token' node at it. The flow then exchanges it for a 24-hour data access token and uses only that. Spot prices are NOT fetched here - they come from Energi Data Service, which needs no credential, so the `elpris` widget fetches them in plain Python. Consumption is pushed as integer thousandths of a kWh. The payload declares expected_minutes so /poc/systems can judge it instead of reporting an unknown cadence.
